original_review.status: preserved unchanged; this note supplements its design-only recommendation

orientation_clarification.formula: raw feature per cycle = president_party_asof (+1 D, -1 R) * ln(P_US_regular_retail_TWIP,current / P_US_regular_retail_TWIP,91_days_prior); then standardize using one equal-weight value per strictly earlier, gas-supported election cycle, population SD (ddof=0), training-only mean/SD
orientation_clarification.reason: This copies E01's p-first orient-then-standardize convention. It makes a single coefficient express the same president-party-oriented salience coordinate when the president's party changes; target remains the Democratic share D/(D+R). The coefficient is sign-unrestricted and this orientation is not a causal sign claim.
orientation_clarification.prior_geometry: Do not standardize raw gasoline change first and multiply by party afterward: that is a different feature and changes intercept/party shifts and target-fold prior-predictive geometry. Any such alternative would be a separately versioned specification.
orientation_clarification.direct_critique: Sol confirmed the E01 transform is the appropriate template. His audit found the 2022 target standardized value is -1.584 under p-first versus -0.785 under raw-first; a Normal(0,0.05) coefficient therefore has different implied prior geometry across those transforms.

cutoff_clarification.owner_cutoff: The selected economic adapter defines inclusive 00:00 UTC at election day minus fourteen calendar days.
cutoff_clarification.panel_issue: TWIP panel cutoff_utc fields encode end-of-H14-day 23:59:59 UTC, which is a looser convention; do not carry that field into a future feature join as the owner cutoff.
cutoff_clarification.source_evidence: The conservative TWIP report upper bounds are before exact-midnight H14 for all 12 panel cycles, per the independent Sol source audit. A future implementation must explicitly rebind each value to the owner cutoff and retain the per-row comparison; this does not authenticate original posting logs or revisions.

authorization_and_development_clarificat.standing_goal: The prior phrase 'any fit requires separate authorization' means a separate owner-controlled implementation/run plan and equal matched budgets, not a request for new user permission. The standing improvement goal already authorizes root's implementation, verification, and launch within resource ownership.
authorization_and_development_clarificat.benchmark_reuse: A2018, A2022, B2020, and B2024 may be reused iteratively as development benchmarks under the applicable verification workflow. No untouched-holdout cycle is a prerequisite. Report all four as exposed development evidence, never as untouched validation.
authorization_and_development_clarificat.future_specification_changes: The current G01 hypothesis remains frozen for this proposed comparison, but there is no blanket ban on later justified retuning. A materially changed feature, transform, prior, or comparison must receive a new version, explain its rationale, and report exposure/reuse of these same benchmarks. No fit is launched by this clarification.

confirmed_recommendation: Prepare G01 as design only; any later execution uses matched-support F0 versus F0+G01, the p-first transform above, one common sign-unrestricted coefficient, exact owner H14 cutoffs, and cycle-level retrospective reporting.
